questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "short-covering bounce" mean?
options: A quick rise in stock prices caused by investors buying back shares they previously sold short
A government policy that lowers taxes
A decline in stock prices due to companies cutting dividends
A stable market where no one trades
questions.explain_en: A short-covering bounce is a short-term rise in price when traders who sold stocks short buy them back to close their positions.
questions.explain_zh: 「short-covering bounce」指的是空頭回補，投資人買回先前賣空的股票，導致股價短暫上漲。

questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "fair value" mean?
